title: Data Centers Design & Implementation Expert
desc:
Join Us
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What You’ll Do
Design, implement and follow up power, cooling, structured cabling and floor layout, by considering industry standards, requirements and best practices in line with the budget
Coordinate vendor and subcontractor activities
Communicate with internal customers to address their requirements and needs
Responding to customer specifications by working closely with Presales and sales teams
Creating installation plans in line with customer demands and addressing the necessary preparations on site
Coordinating with other teams and stakeholders to prepare white spaces in data centers for internal and external customer installations
Managing footprint, energy and cooling capacities in data centers according to installation plans and creating necessary investment plans
Carrying out processes to clarify internal and external customer demands, determine needs and ensure their supply
Plan and implement energy saving and cost cutting projects
Have good knowledge on data center physical infrastructure standards by global organizations TIA, ASHRAE, IEC..etc
Plan project work flows, project organization and timeline and make essential revisions in the project scope and timeline
Provision the cost of each design activity and forecast future site requirements
Make essential reporting to Vodafone Group IT, NW Core teams etc
Prepare periodic project progress reports/system status reports
Prepare the engineering plans and site technical design packages/specs. for infrastructure and energy systems
Generate floor layout and site cabling design
Do capacity planning on power and cooling infrastructures
Prepare technical product specifications and installation guidelines
Negotiate technical issues with vendors, manufacturers and suppliers
Coordinate installation/decommissioning/re-homing of infrastructure and energy systems at existing and new mission critical centers
Monitor/track/report progress of project plans/milestones
Implement assessment deliverables to boost site efficiency
Conduct and supervise installation subcontractors onsite
Communicate with stakeholders at NW, IT and other domains
Search new generation systems and best practices for OPEX saving and cost effectiveness
Improve the site efficiency, lowering the PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) metric
Follow up the energy comsumptions of the technology centers

Who We Are
We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.
Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. ;We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.
